recent.text: Matthew Tkachuk praised Devon Levi postgame: “He’s a really good goalie.” As he did Connor McDavid: “Obviously McDavid’s controlling every single game he’s playing in right now, and he’s on a whole other level than anybody else in the league right now.”

recent.text: Panthers only gave up 6 scoring chances at 5-on-5 tonight. Forsling: “I like our gap. I think we didn't give them that much. Obviously they scored on a power play a couple of times there, which took the wind out of us a little bit. We did come back and pushed a little bit.”
